name: Llama 3.2 Vision Instruct
short: Meta's Sep 2024 open-weight 11B/90B vision model (128K, 4K out) for document/chart QA: DocVQA 88.4, AI2D 91.1, MMMU 50.7 - now delisted by most hosts.
pricingNote: Open weights (Llama 3.2 Community License); hosted $0.0485-$0.35 per 1M in, $0.055-$0.676 out
pricingTiers: Hosted from $0.0485/M in (Cloudflare Workers AI) to $0.35/M (io.net 90B); DeepInfra $0.345/$0.345
Self-host $0 (Llama 3.2 Community License; EU multimodal clause applies)
standout: The legacy vision workhorse for document, chart and diagram reading from open weights.
tradeoff: A 4,096-token output cap, no audio/video, and Together, Groq, Cerebras and OpenRouter have all delisted both sizes.
